Review the result for -5 celsius; it displays -551.30 °C.
Review the following supplied conversions: -10 celsius in fahrenheit displays -969.34 °F, -40 fahrenheit in celsius displays -550.74 °C, and -65 fahrenheit in celsius displays -564.63 °C.
